title: a11y_deutan and a11y_protan goldens are byte-identical (same git blob hash before AND after) — two different CVD modes cannot render identical pixels
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/a11y_deutan/65000ms.png b/goldens/a11y_deutan/65000ms.png
index d46aa141..b902d59e 100644
diff --git a/goldens/a11y_protan/65000ms.png b/goldens/a11y_protan/65000ms.png
index d46aa141..b902d59e 100644
detail: Git blob ids are content hashes: both modes' PNGs were identical before (d46aa141) and are identical after (b902d59e) the re-bless. Distinct Machado deutan vs protan remaps of a colorful frame must differ; at least one golden is not validating its mode's remap. Tritan correctly differs.
recommended_fix: Re-capture deutan and protan independently with the mode verified as threaded into the capture; until then these two goldens cannot detect a single-mode remap regression. Pre-existing, but this re-bless perpetuates it.

title: Content_Host play-triangle glyph stays hardcoded raw while its host body, roof, wash, and chip all recede
detail: A non-involved host keeps a fully-saturated white glyph mid-crisis. The never-recede list exempts only the router LED; every other identity surface on this node (body, roof, wash, chip glyph) recedes. The triangle is the sole unexempted raw outlier.
recommended_fix: Either fade the triangle with crisis_recede_scale like the chip glyph, or add it to the documented never-recede exemption list with a rationale — the current state contradicts the stated contract.

title: draw_type_chip outline stays full-strength on receded nodes while its glyph fades to 35%
evidence:
out.a = u8(255 * fade)
 		rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx({x0, y0, cw, ch}, max(1.0, s * 0.02 * reveal_scale), out)
 		glyph := fam
-		glyph.a = u8(255 * fade)
+		glyph.a = u8(255 * fade * crisis_recede_scale(recede))
detail: The chip's ink outline keeps full alpha on non-involved nodes while the glyph it frames fades — half the chip recedes, half does not. Possibly deliberate (paper chrome), but undocumented in the never-recede list.
recommended_fix: Decide and document: fade the outline with the glyph, or name it exempt chrome in the contract comment so the asymmetry is a decision, not an oversight.
